title: Frozen-coordinate higher-level curvature retrieval and application
summary: Retrieve qualified directional electronic curvatures or assigned literature harmonic frequencies; construct a hash-bound replacement ledger in the frozen lower-level frame, without double counting.
gates: Freeze geometry, isotopologue, atom order, ESALC-I definition, masses, normal-coordinate normalization, symmetry and source-field hashes before retrieval
Record exact method, basis, frozen-core treatment, relativistic/core-valence scope and triples scaling; CCSD(T*)-F12c is not CCSD(T)-F12c
Reuse matching electronic checkpoints; no electronic job is launched by retrieval or validation; a new finite sample plan requires explicit authorization

Literature route requires a primary source/table/row, conformer and isotopologue identity, true harmonic frequencies, one-to-one symmetry assignment and explicit mode-shape assumption when eigenvectors are absent
Frequency rank alone is not a mode assignment; near-degenerate modes require an explicit subspace treatment before scalar replacement
In dimensionless frozen q with G0=omega_ref, convert literature frequency to curvature K=omega_high squared / omega_ref; never substitute frequency directly or add an origin correction
Electronic route requires the same back-transformation, reference energy/state, at least two declared central steps and a finite-difference uncertainty within a predeclared bound
Retain the directional gradient or document a bounded neglect; recenter a shifted hybrid field with joint transport of potential, full metric/scalar and properties
Replace target minus CURRENT diagonal exactly once; reject duplicate update identifiers and mismatched parent-field hashes; preserve unacquired mixed terms
Curvature replacement alone never qualifies an XH variational profile: physical bond derivatives 2/3/4, independent electronic validation, global shape and modal checks are separate mandatory gates
Keep experimental fundamentals out of source selection, fitting and threshold tuning; report assignment/model/numerical uncertainties separately
Keep source and failed artifacts immutable; write a new output with provenance, protocol hash and an explicit application versus spectral qualification distinction
coordinate_policy: Freeze the source frame. Apply scalar diagonal replacements only with certified correspondence. Carry gradients; transform all operators together if recentering or changing coordinates. No silent rotation of incomplete derivative tensors.
backend_policy: Pure retrieval/validation and replacement-ledger preparation from existing artifacts; no electronic scheduler, no spectral fit and no automatic field or checkpoint overwrite.
